Job Title: Data Analyst Intern (Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python)


Company: Crossing Infotech
Location: Remote (open to candidates anywhere in India)
Employment Type: Full-time internship


Duration: 1 to 3 months


Stipend: INR 17,000 per month


About the role
Every business sits on a pile of numbers that nobody has had time to read. As a Data Analyst Intern at Crossing Infotech, your job is to read them, make sense of them, and tell the team what they mean. You will work on real business data, not textbook samples, and your dashboards and reports will be used by the people making day-to-day decisions.
This is a hands-on, full-time remote internship built for people who enjoy spotting patterns, asking why a number moved, and turning a messy spreadsheet into a clear story.


What you will do

Collect, clean and organise data from spreadsheets, databases and internal tools

Write SQL queries to pull the exact data the team needs

Build interactive dashboards in Power BI and structured reports in Excel

Use Python (Pandas) to automate repetitive data cleaning where possible

Track key business metrics and highlight trends, dips and opportunities

Prepare short weekly summaries that explain findings in plain language

Check data for errors, duplicates and gaps before it reaches a report

Work with team members to understand what questions the data needs to answer


What we are looking for

Good working knowledge of Excel (formulas, pivot tables, lookups, charts)

Basic to intermediate SQL (SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, filters)

Familiarity with Power BI or a similar tool such as Tableau or Looker Studio

Basic Python with Pandas is a plus, not a must

Clear written communication, so your insights are easy to follow 
A careful, detail-focused way of working 
A stable laptop and reliable internet connection for full-time remote work


Who can apply

Students in their final years or recent graduates from any stream, including B.Tech, BCA, B.Sc, B.Com, BBA, MCA, MBA and others

Self-taught learners who can show their skills through a project, a portfolio or a certification

Anyone available to work full-time for the internship duration


What you will gain

Work on live business data and real reporting tasks

Regular feedback and guidance from experienced team members 
A portfolio of dashboards and analysis you can show in future interviews

Internship completion certificate

Flexibility of working from your own city


Schedule
Full-time, Monday to Saturday or as assigned by your reporting manager, with daily check-ins and weekly review sessions.
How to apply
Apply through this listing with your updated resume. If you have a dashboard, a GitHub project or a data case study, add the link. It helps us see your work faster.
Crossing Infotech is an equal opportunity organisation. We welcome applicants of every gender, background and community. There is no fee at any stage of our hiring process.

jobs.description:
Join AuthBridge in Thrissur as a SQL Data Analyst. The role sits close to the business: you will define the metrics, build the reporting behind them, and be the person the team asks when a number looks wrong.

About the role
This SQL Data Analyst role is hands-on and delivery-focused. Expect to spend your time writing the SQL that extracts, models and validates business data, working primarily in SQL and relational databases. You will own your outputs end to end — from the data pull and the sanity checks to the final recommendation.

Key responsibilities
• Write, optimise and document SQL for analysis and reporting
• Model and join data across many source tables reliably
• Build the curated datasets that feed dashboards
• Reconcile query output against source systems before publishing
• Support ad-hoc data requests with fast, correct answers
• Validate and reconcile numbers before they are published, and document known data caveats
• Automate recurring reporting so the team spends its time on analysis rather than refreshes
• Present findings to non-technical stakeholders in clear, plain language

Required skills and tools
• SQL
• Query Optimisation
• Joins & Window Functions
• Stored Procedures
• Data Modelling
• Advanced Excel
• Power BI
• Data Validation
• ETL Concepts
• Indexing Basics
• Analytical Thinking
• Documentation

Eligibility criteria
• Education: B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA/B.Sc or an equivalent degree. Candidates from any recognised university are welcome.
• Graduation year: 2023–2026 batches. Freshers and final-year students awaiting results may apply.
• Minimum 60% / 6.0 CGPA in the highest qualification (indicative — strong practical skills can offset this).
• Experience: 0–3 years in analytics, reporting, MIS or a closely related function.
• Technical skills: SQL, Query Optimisation, Joins & Window Functions, Stored Procedures, Data Modelling, Advanced Excel.
• Soft skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, stakeholder communication, ownership and the confidence to flag a number that looks wrong.

Salary and compensation
• Annual CTC: ₹3,50,000 – ₹7,90,000 per year (3.5 LPA – 7.9 LPA), an indicative market range for this role in Thrissur.
• Monthly equivalent: approximately ₹48,000 per month at the mid-point of the range.
• Currency: INR (₹).
• Performance bonus / variable pay as per AuthBridge's policy, reviewed annually.
• The exact offer is confirmed by AuthBridge based on your interview performance and current compensation.

Perks and benefits
• Clear appraisal cycle and internal mobility
• Employee wellness programmes
• Team offsites and networking opportunities
• Competitive salary as per market benchmarks
• Annual performance bonus / variable pay
• Health insurance for you and your dependants
• Provident Fund and statutory benefits
• Structured onboarding and mentorship

Location, work mode and employment type
• Location: Thrissur, Kerala
• Work mode: Remote (Work From Home)
• Employment type: Full-time, permanent
• Working hours: 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM, Monday to Friday
• Number of openings: 4
• Joining: immediate to 60 days, as per your notice period

Selection process
• Round 1 — Resume screening and profile shortlisting by the talent acquisition team
• Round 2 — Technical interview 2 — BI tooling, dashboard design and metric definition
• Round 3 — HR discussion — compensation, notice period, joining date and offer roll-out

Who should apply
Candidates from B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA/B.Sc or an equivalent degree with up to 3 years of relevant experience who are based in Thrissur or willing to relocate. You should be comfortable with SQL, Query Optimisation, Joins & Window Functions and able to explain your analysis to someone who has never seen the data. Portfolio projects, Kaggle work, a GitHub repo or published dashboards strengthen an application, especially for early-career candidates.

Why join AuthBridge
Working at AuthBridge means modern tooling, clean processes and colleagues who will review your logic properly. Analysts here grow into senior, lead and specialist tracks. Career growth is performance-linked and reviewed on a regular cycle, with internal mobility across analytics, product and business teams actively supported. You will leave every year of this role with the query layer every dashboard in your team is built on.

jobs.title: AI Analytics Workflow Evaluator
jobs.description:
The WorkYou will assess how AI assistants handle realistic analytics workflows connected to cloud data warehouses. Your work will help check whether generated figures, SQL queries, joins, filters, and time windows are accurate and logically sound.

The role combines hands-on data analysis, Snowflake environment management, investigation of product behavior, and careful evaluation of AI-generated results.

Run structured evaluation scenarios involving anomaly investigations, KPI reporting, and data refreshes.Write and run SQL queries to compare AI-generated results with source data.Maintain, reset, and manage seeded Snowflake datasets so test scenarios stay accurate and repeatable.Administer warehouse roles, permissions, grants, and access controls in secure evaluation environments.Set up and document connectivity and authentication across analytics and SaaS platforms.Investigate undocumented product behavior and record your findings clearly.Join calibration sessions to keep grading and scoring consistent across evaluators.What It Pays and TakesThis is a part-time contractor role for someone who can work carefully with analytics systems and judge whether AI-generated analysis is correct. The role is marked entry level, while three or more years of hands-on data analyst or analytics engineer experience is preferred.

Pay: $50 to $60 per hour.Time: At least 20 hours per week.Work arrangement: Part-time contract work.Language: English.Location: Open to applicants in the countries listed for this role.Required: Advanced SQL skills and expertise with Snowflake warehouses, access controls, and query history.Required: Ability to audit and reconcile reported metrics against raw data and find subtle aggregation or logic errors.Required: Strong written and verbal communication, careful documentation, and sound judgment when evaluating analytical results.Valuable experience: Database access administration, roles and grants, authentication, or security integrations.Helpful background: Business and finance analytics, including KPI definitions and reporting for leaders or external stakeholders.Helpful experience: Claude or ChatGPT connectors, reviewing AI-generated SQL and analysis, rubric-based evaluation, quality assurance, or data labeling.Also useful: OAuth, security integrations, Slack, Google Workspace, or Microsoft 365.How It WorksApply on OpenTrain with your resume, then complete the application on the hiring site.

About AI Training WorkAI training is the human work behind systems that analyze information and produce answers. Evaluators check model outputs against reliable data, and experienced analysts are paid for the judgment needed to catch errors that automated checks can miss.
